args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with error rate at 18%. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and was **unhealthy**; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — verified as rolled out.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, describing the health-check failures since the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. On-call was paged.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.2%.

Note: the rollback was to a previously healthy production version, so no change approval was required.
